Allah swears by the running horses, breathing hard.
And by the horses that make sparks with their hooves.
And by the horses that rush at dawn.
And rushing into the middle of the enemy.
Truly, man does not say thank you to his Lord.
And he himself is a witness to it.
And he loves money very much.
Does he not know that when what is in the graves is thrown out?
And what is in the hearts is brought out?
On that Day their Lord will know all about them.
